title: dsImaging validation demo
text: 1. Connect DataSHIELD nodes. Open one session across three Opal servers register validation resource. 2. Initialise resource resolve site’s dataset. Bind shared resource handle, confirm images masks validate, read per-site dataset identifier Opal resolves resource . 3. Run six imaging workflows. Submit workflow family every site. dsHPC executes runners inside Rock workers publishes derived assets back site’s catalogue. 4. Load published asset inspect . jobs finish, load published asset server-side summarise ordinary DataSHIELD functions.
code: library(DSI) library(DSOpal) library(dsImagingClient) library(dsBaseClient)  builder <- DSI::newDSLoginBuilder() builder$append(server = "opal1", url = "https://opal-node-1.example.org",                user = "researcher", password = "********") builder$append(server = "opal2", url = "https://opal-node-2.example.org",                user = "researcher", password = "********") builder$append(server = "opal3", url = "https://opal-node-3.example.org",                user = "researcher", password = "********") conns <- DSI::datashield.login(builder$build(), assign = FALSE) ds.imaging.init(conns, resource = "dsdemo.imaging_demo", symbol = "img") ds.imaging.validate(conns, "img")  dataset_ids <- vapply(ds.imaging.metadata(conns, "img"),                       function(m) m$dataset_id, character(1)) for (srv in names(conns)) {   cx  <- conns[srv]   did <- dataset_ids[[srv]]    ds.imaging.qc.metrics(     cx, dataset_id = did, image_asset = "images", mask_asset = "masks",     output_asset = "demo_qc_metrics", visibility = "global"   )   ds.imaging.mask.operation(     cx, dataset_id = did, operation = "connected_components",     mask_asset = "masks", reference_asset = "images",     min_voxels = 5L, max_components = 1L,     output_asset = "demo_masks_cc", visibility = "global"   )   ds.imaging.spatial.process(     cx, dataset_id = did, image_asset = "images",     operations = "crop_to_mask", mask_asset = "masks",     output_asset = "demo_crop_to_mask", visibility = "global"   )   ds.imaging.embeddings.extract(     cx, dataset_id = did, image_asset = "images",     model = "intensity_histogram", bins = 16L,     output_asset = "demo_embeddings", visibility = "global"   )   ds.imaging.radiomics.process_collection(     cx, dataset_id = did,     segmenter = ds.imaging.segmenter.existing_mask("masks"),     profile = ds.imaging.radiomics.profile.demo_ct_firstorder(),     visibility = "global"   )   ds.imaging.radiomics.segment_and_extract(     cx, dataset_id = did,     segmenter = ds.imaging.segmenter.ct_lung_threshold(       threshold = -320, max_components = 2L, min_voxels = 100L     ),     profile = ds.imaging.radiomics.profile.demo_ct_firstorder(),     visibility = "global"   ) } for (srv in names(conns)) {   ds.imaging.load_asset(conns[srv], dataset_ids[[srv]], "demo_qc_metrics",                         symbol = "qc", include_metadata = TRUE,                         syntactic_names = TRUE) }  ds.dim("qc", datasources = conns) ds.mean("qc$mask_volume", datasources = conns)  DSI::datashield.logout(conns)

title: Federated LUNG1 radiomics study
text: 1. Connect DataSHIELD nodes. Open one session across three Opal servers register LUNG1 imaging resource. 2. Initialise imaging resource. Bind LUNG1 resource server-side handle confirm CT images GTV-1 masks readable job runs. 3. Extract Aerts radiomics signature. Submit one collection workflow existing tumour masks Aerts profile. dsHPC schedules per-image PyRadiomics jobs site; call reports queued. 4. Publish load feature table. every per-image job finished, commit completed outputs asset catalogue load — joined clinical metadata — server-side DataSHIELD table. 5. Analyse federated feature table. rad now ordinary server-side DataSHIELD table. Check dimensions, summarise Aerts features fit federated two-year-survival GLM features clinical covariates.
code: library(DSI) library(DSOpal) library(dsImagingClient) library(dsBaseClient)  builder <- DSI::newDSLoginBuilder() builder$append(server = "opal1", url = "https://opal-node-1.example.org",                user = "researcher", password = "********") builder$append(server = "opal2", url = "https://opal-node-2.example.org",                user = "researcher", password = "********") builder$append(server = "opal3", url = "https://opal-node-3.example.org",                user = "researcher", password = "********") conns <- DSI::datashield.login(builder$build(), assign = FALSE) ds.imaging.init(conns, resource = "dsdemo.lung1_study", symbol = "img") ds.imaging.validate(conns, "img") result <- ds.imaging.radiomics.process_collection(   conns,   dataset_id = NULL,   segmenter  = ds.imaging.segmenter.existing_mask("masks"),   profile    = ds.imaging.radiomics.profile.aerts_signature(),   batch_size = 1L,   visibility = "global" ) pub <- ds.imaging.radiomics.collection_publish(   conns,   generation_id = result$generation_id,   dataset_id    = result$dataset_id )  ds.imaging.radiomics.load_features(   conns,   dataset_id       = pub$dataset_id,   asset_id         = pub$asset_id,   symbol           = "rad",   include_metadata = TRUE,   syntactic_names  = TRUE ) ds.dim("rad", datasources = conns) ds.mean("rad$original_firstorder_Energy", datasources = conns)  ds.glmSLMA(   formula = os_2yr_alive ~ original_firstorder_Energy +     original_shape_Compactness1 +     original_glrlm_RunLengthNonUniformity +     wavelet.HLH_glrlm_RunLengthNonUniformity +     age + gender_male,   family      = "binomial",   dataName    = "rad",   datasources = conns )  DSI::datashield.logout(conns)
